name: Warm Canvas
description: A calm, editorial creator edit built around your own footage: full-frame talking head with a few clean serif captions, then a warm off-white canvas with a soft swoosh where white cards explain the idea while you shrink into a rounded picture-in-picture.
style: Two modes only: full-frame A-roll with one centred Fraunces caption (key words in sky blue #4f9cf0) and small side chips, or the warm canvas (#f7f5f4 with one big swoosh) with the speaker in a rounded 272x384 PiP and the content in the left column. White cards, radius 20, pastel tags, gentle fades and soft counters, never a bounce. Quiet tactile sound: paper slides, wooden taps, one warm pad.
